semantics.denominator: Externally measured full ordinary Simulation.step elapsed, including its pending wait loop.

semantics.residual_us: Full step minus root spans and observed handlers: outer step setup, pending sleeps, call/return gaps and timer precision.
semantics.root_stages: Disjoint spans in the original step_nonblocking phase order; observed handler time removed.

semantics.root: Full-window disjoint root-stage spans; total equals stages + measured observer handlers + residual.
semantics.all: Only declared selected complete steps contribute to nested-function totals. Every preceding ordinary step still executes.
semantics.nested: Inclusive rows overlap. Exclusive subtracts timed descendants. Never add nested rows to root spans or add overlapping inclusive rows together.
semantics.counter_absence: A missing query counter field is unobserved, not an independently observed zero. Wrapper coverage establishes whether a covered function was called during a selected step.
semantics.actual_branches: diag_environment_* counters are inserted inside actual cache/build branches. Counts are read outside the measured full-step timer.
semantics.bounded_groups: Compact argument/result group examples are bounded and available in raw NDJSON. Equal compact keys do not prove reusable world facts or permissions.
semantics.full_window_vs_functions: Full-window metrics and selected-step function totals have different denominators and remain separate.
